craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of led difference; vyabhicāri vismayotsāha at Whole descending. Sanskrit-first: vata (OH — kept per UNC; exclamation breathes); svecchā-vikāsa (WILL'S-OWN-SPREADING — kept). Rows: 7 (vata-exclamation — wonder voiced), 1 (‘Śiva-made’ closes — fear melted into identity last). Close: ‘fear melted, I am Śiva-made’. Rupture: semicolon (descent stated, then its effect — praised, fear melts). Rejected: cutting vata — killed: exclamation breathes; ‘made-of-Śiva’ — killed: Śiva-made kept (verdict formula). Read aloud: FROM the-BRIMM-ing-WHOLE — OH, TASTE-spill-ing-JOY — YOU-lead YOUR-pow-ER … PRICE-less, YOUR-free-DOM — PRAIS-ing YOUR-won-der-be-COME-pow-ER, FEAR-melt-ed, I-AM ŚI-va-MADE.

lines: From the brimming Whole — oh, taste spilling joy — You lead Your power
into difference, by will's own spreading; priceless, Your freedom — praising Your wonder-become power, fear melted, I am Śiva-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nijāṃ śaktiṃ bhedaṃ gamayasi nijecchāprasarataḥ | anarghaṃ svātantryaṃ tava
